name: Can I use an ADU as a short-term rental in areas like Santa Monica or Beverly Hills?

mainEntity.name: Can I use an ADU as a short-term rental in areas like Santa Monica or Beverly Hills?

acceptedAnswer.text: Regulations for short-term rentals (like Airbnb) for ADUs vary significantly by city in Los Angeles County. While ADUs can be rented long-term in most areas, some cities, including Santa Monica and Beverly Hills, have very strict ordinances regarding short-term rentals. For example, Santa Monica generally prohibits non-primary residents from short-term renting. Beverly Hills also has stringent rules. It's crucial to check the specific short-term rental ordinances of your city before planning to use your ADU for this purpose, as non-compliance can lead to significant penalties.
acceptedAnswer.description: Short-term rental rules for ADUs vary by city. Cities like Santa Monica and Beverly Hills have strict prohibitions or limitations on non-primary residents using ADUs for short-term rentals.
